entries.what: HeyGen's Streaming API paths /v1/streaming.create_token, /v1/streaming.new and /v1/streaming.start are gone from api.heygen.com, so an avatar session can't start. Checked on 2026-11-05: an unauthenticated POST returns the host's 404 page, the same as a path that never existed, while /v2/avatars on that host answers with a JSON error. HeyGen's Streaming docs pages now 404, so no shutdown date could be read and the date is only the day it was checked.

source.quote: The requested URL was not found on the server.

entries.replacement: LiveAvatar, which HeyGen's docs point real-time avatars at: https://developers.heygen.com/live-avatar.md
requires: LiveAvatar has its own API, documented at docs.liveavatar.com, so this is a rewrite of the session flow and not a new path.

entries.what: The @heygen/streaming-avatar package is deprecated, and it defaults to https://api.heygen.com and calls /v1/streaming.new there, which HG-1 covers. createStartAvatar fails with it unless a basePath points somewhere else.
lookFor: An import or dependency of @heygen/streaming-avatar, or a call of createStartAvatar on it.
entries.replacement: @heygen/liveavatar-web-sdk, as the package's own notice says.
requires: Run npm i @heygen/liveavatar-web-sdk, as the notice says, and move the session flow to LiveAvatar's API.
